name: Mutou Yayoi
source:
At first glance she appears to be a total klutz, but further inspection reveals she's actually an incredible athlete.
This poor girl is always nearby when Nanaka is in trouble, and seems to take great care (at her own expense) to keep Nanaka safe.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071113213710/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dayoflove/p_cha06.html]Hirameki[/url]]
